patient.living_situation: Lives alone; her sister lives in the same town
patient.social_context: Sees her sister weekly; few other regular contacts
patient.background: Fictional former bus driver, divorced, lives alone and manages ongoing back pain.
patient.history_summary: Prescription opioid use that began after a back injury in 2015 and rose beyond the prescribed amount from 2018.
patient.treatment_summary: In a supervised medication program since April 2022; completed a pain management program in 2023.

history_events.description: Back injury at work; first prescription for pain, which starts her use of opioid medication.
Takes more than the prescribed amount because the pain is not controlled.
Tells her primary care doctor she is finding it hard to cut down.
Divorce is finalized and she moves into a smaller flat.

factors.description: Pain flare-ups, especially in cold weather.
Poor sleep after a painful day.
Attends clinic appointments reliably and keeps a daily routine.

interventions.reported_outcome: Attendance has been steady; no missed appointments in the 12 months before the last check-in.

progress.note: Attending the clinic reliably; worries about her pain returning.
No missed appointments in the past 12 months.
